<script type="text/javascript">
            // update status bar text when value changes
            const handleChange = (e) => {
                const { value } = e.detail;
                const percentage = Math.round(value * 100000) / 1000;
                e.target.setText(`${percentage}% complete`);
            };

            download_progress_obj.addEventListener('change', handleChange);
            upload_progress_obj.addEventListener('change', handleChange);

            // show generic text when in pulse-mode
            download_progress_obj.addEventListener('pulse', (e) => {
                e.target.setText('downloading...');
            });

            // increase value on mouse movement
            const handleMouseMove = (e, progress_bar) => {
                var value = progress_bar.getValue();
                if (value > 1) {
                    progress_bar.pulse();
                } else {
                    progress_bar.setValue(value + 0.01);
                }
            };

            document.getElementById('download_progress').addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                handleMouseMove(e, download_progress_obj);
            });

            // set random value on mouse click
            const handleClick = (e, progress_bar) => {
                const value = Math.round(Math.random() * 100) / 100;
                progress_bar.setValueWithAnimation(value);
            }
            document.getElementById('upload_progress').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                handleClick(e, upload_progress_obj);
            });

            </script>
